answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 22 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the basalt solution is checked at the velvet gate and logged, the jade audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
